battle.name: 東郡之戰
battle.brief: 北周大象二年（580）七月，尉遲迥起兵反楊堅，遣儀同宇文威攻東郡，郡守于仲文出城迎戰破敵，斬五百餘人；滎州刺史宇文胄自石濟西進，宇文威沿黃河南下，兩路合圍。城內赫連僧伽、敬子哲通敵，于仲文遂率六十餘騎自西門突圍退回長安。此役無拋石機參戰，卡面投石機乃攻城器械譜系的標記。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 北周大象二年（580）七月，北周朝廷與以相州總管尉遲迥為首的河北叛軍，在東郡（治滑臺，今河南滑縣東舊城）爆發衝突。朝廷一方由東郡太守于仲文率郡兵據守滑臺城，這支部隊隸屬北周在司州、冀州之間的州郡駐軍，編制以郡兵步卒、弩手與城內少量騎兵為主，糧秣靠黃河漕運與洛陽方向的就地徵發維持。叛軍一方則是握有相州兵權的尉遲迥，他以趙王與相州總管的名義起兵於鄴，旬日之間趙、魏、齊、兗、鄴五州皆響應，兵眾號稱數十萬，屬於河北世族與州鎮武人支持的區域性叛亂，而不是中央可以用一道詔書調動的常備部隊。叛軍分作數路：檀讓領兵向河南洛陽方向進逼，儀同宇文威率所部直取東郡，滎州刺史宇文胄自石濟津向西策應。城內又有赫連僧伽、敬子哲等地方豪族與官吏與叛軍通款，使守軍的處境遠比城牆本身危急。整場戰爭因此不是兩個中央政權之間的會戰，而是一場內戰中某一個郡城的防衛與陷落，是楊堅平定河北諸州反撲的第一個實戰環節。
countriesEn: The Dongjun campaign of the seventh month of the Daxiang 2nd year (580) was fought at Dongjun, whose seat was Butai (today the old eastern city of Hua County, Henan), between the court of the Western Zhou and a rebellion in Hebei led by Yuchi Jiong, Inspector General of Xiang Province. On the court side, Yuzhongwen, Governor of Dongjun, led the commandery troops in holding Butai; this was a small provincial garrison of foot soldiers, crossbowmen and a few riders, kept in the field on grain carried along the Yellow River and requisitioned locally toward Luoyang. On the rebel side stood Yuchi Jiong, who held the military authority of Xiang Province and rose at Ye in the capacity of Prince of Zhao and Inspector General; within ten days the five provinces of Zhao, Wei, Qi, Yong and Ye answered his call and the host was counted in tens of thousands, a regional revolt backed by Hebei aristocratic and garrison families rather than a standing army the centre could move by a single edict. The insurgents split into several columns: Tanrang pressed toward Henan and Luoyang, the Gentleman of the Household Yuwen Wei led a direct attack on Dongjun, and Yuwen Zhou, Inspector of Xingzhou, moved west from Shiji Ford. Inside the walls, Helian Sengjia, Jing Zizhe and other local functionaries and landowners were already in contact with the insurgents, which made the garrison's position far more precarious than the walls alone suggested. The engagement was therefore not a set-piece battle between two central governments but the defence and loss of one commandery city in the course of a civil war, and it was the first practical step in Yang Jian's campaign to reduce the rebellious provinces of Hebei.
people: 于仲文是本役的守將，職銜為北周東郡太守，郡治滑臺。他沒有坐等援軍，而是抓住敵軍先鋒孤軍突出的時機，率郡兵出城野戰，一戰擊破儀同宇文威，斬獲五百餘人，穩住了剛接手的郡城。當尉遲迥改以石濟、白馬兩路合圍，又遇上城內赫連僧伽、敬子哲準備接應內應之後，他判斷城內軍心已不在自己手上，遂不再投入兵力固守，率六十餘騎自西門突圍，途中遭追殺而終於退回長安。回到京城之後，楊堅並未追究城陷，反而任命他為河南道行軍總管，赴洛陽發兵，進討檀讓，並在梁郡之戰中取勝，可見其長才在野戰指揮而不在坐守孤城。尉遲迥本人是北周的重臣、宇文泰的外甥，長期出任相州總管，是河北實際的軍事支柱，他的起兵改變了中原的政治格局。宇文威、宇文胄是攻城的兩路主將，檀讓負責東線的河南方向，楊堅是平叛的總帥，高穎在幕中策劃分割敵勢、逐路平定的方略。
peopleEn: Yuzhongwen, Governor of Dongjun and the defender of Butai, was the man of the hour. Rather than sit and wait for relief, he watched for the moment when the rebel vanguard had advanced too far, marched out of the city with the commandery troops, broke Yuwen Wei's leading elements in the field and took more than five hundred enemy dead, which steadied a town he had only just taken charge of. When Yuchi Jiong changed his plan to close the city with two columns out of Shiji and Baima, and with Helian Sengjia and Jing Zizhe preparing to admit the rebels from within, Yuzhongwen judged that the garrison's loyalty had already gone. He stopped spending men on holding the place: with a little over sixty riders he broke out of the west gate, was pursued on the way and yet managed to reach Chang'an. Back at the capital Yang Jian did not punish him for the loss of the city; he appointed him Commander of the March for Henan, sent him to raise troops at Luoyang and attack Tanrang, and there he won the action at Liang Commandery. His strength lay in command in the open field, not in sitting behind a single wall. Yuchi Jiong himself was a weighty figure of the late Western Zhou, a nephew of Yuwen Tai and, as Inspector General of Xiang, the real military pillar of Hebei; his rising changed the political map of the central plain. Yuwen Wei and Yuwen Zhou led the two assault columns, Tanrang covered the eastern line toward Henan, Yang Jian was the overall commander of the suppression, and Gao Ying stood behind him, planning to divide the enemy's strength and crush the several risings one by one.
kits: 本卡面兵器是投石機（Onager），即以絞盤把蓄下的勢能換成一塊飛石頭的羅馬式攻城機，自公元前三世紀以來一直是西方圍城戰的標準裝備。但東郡之戰的現存記載（《資治通鑑》卷一百七十四、中文維基〈東郡之戰〉條）從頭到尾沒有出現投石機；中原軍隊所用的同類器械叫「飛石」「發石機」「砲」，原理與 onager 同屬把勢能換成石頭這一門類：先用絞盤、槓桿或配重把能量存進機身，再放開卡榫把石塊拋向城頭。同期中國方面的代表記載是《南史·侯景傳》所記侯景之亂中用來攻打建康的「霹靂車」，以及《梁書·羊侃傳》所記羊侃守玄武湖城時所造的攻城炮具，都是東晉南朝以來仍在使用的拋石機。守城的東郡軍靠的是夯土城牆、角樓與城頭的弓弩，攻城的叛軍則以甲騎為骨幹，配長刀、矛槊、弓箭，以及自石濟、白馬津一線輸送的糧秣；全役沒有記載雲梯、撞車或拋石機的實際使用，勝負落在騎兵反擊與城內內應手上。本站的卡面因此是一個譜系標記，指向攻城機械學的源頭，而不是此役的實物。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the onager, the Roman siege engine that converts energy stored in a winch into a stone in flight; from the third century BC it was standard equipment in western sieges. The surviving record of the Dongjun campaign, the Zizhi Tongjian in volume 174 and the Chinese Wikipedia article on the battle, never mentions an onager. The Chinese machines of that family in this period were called feishi, fashi ji and pao: a frame in which torsion, levers or counterweights stored the energy, released by a catch to throw a stone at the wall. The representative Chinese sources of the same class are the pili che recorded in the Nan Shi biography of Hou Jing, used to batter Jiankang during the Hou Jing rebellion, and the siege engines built by Yang Kan while holding Xuanwu Lake city, described in the Liang Shu; both are throwing engines still in use from the Eastern Jin and Southern Dynasties. The garrison of Dongjun relied on rammed-earth walls, corner towers, and the bows and crossbows of the defenders, while the insurgents leaned on armoured cavalry with sabres, spears and arrows, and on the grain convoys coming in by the Shiji and Baima crossings. Nothing in the record describes ladders, battering rams or throwing engines being used in this engagement; the outcome was settled by a cavalry counterstroke and by traitors inside the walls. The card is therefore a marker of a lineage of siege engineering rather than a description of a machine that stood in Butai.
tactics: 于仲文採取的是以城池為支點、伺機野戰的打法。宇文威率先鋒孤軍抵達滑臺城下時，他沒有閉門死守，而是開城出戰，把有限的郡兵集中成一點，擊潰敵軍先鋒，趁勢斬獲五百餘人；這一次出城反擊同時也暴露了城中兵力的上限。尉遲迥隨即改變部署，命令滎州刺史宇文胄自石濟津向西推進，與宇文威自白馬津沿黃河南岸南下的隊伍形成兩面夾擊，把滑臺與白馬津之間的黃河水路、以及通往西面的官道一併卡斷，使守軍既得不到援兵，也無法再取糧。與此同時，赫連僧伽、敬子哲等人在城內的回應，使于仲文判斷內部已被貫穿，即使城牆不破，守城也會自行瓦解。他遂不再投入兵力固守，率六十餘騎自西門突圍，避開正面合圍，循路西行回到長安，把損失控制在極小範圍。突圍之後的部署更見其長：楊堅以他為河南道行軍總管，令其赴洛陽集兵討檀讓，於梁郡之戰中取勝，把叛軍在東線的支腳先斬斷，再圖鄴城。
tacticsEn: Yuzhongwen fought with the walled town as a pivot, looking for chances to meet the enemy in the open. When Yuwen Wei's vanguard, marching by itself, reached the walls of Butai, he did not shut the gates and wait: he opened them, concentrated the small commandery garrison into a single thrust, broke the attacking vanguard and took more than five hundred dead in the killing. The sortie also revealed the ceiling of his own strength. Yuchi Jiong then changed his arrangements, ordering Yuwen Zhou, Inspector of Xingzhou, to advance west from Shiji Ford while Yuwen Wei came south along the Yellow River from Baima, so that the two columns clamped the city between them and cut both the river route and the western road by which succour and grain might have reached the defenders. At the same time, the readiness of Helian Sengjia and Jing Zizhe to admit the rebels from within convinced Yuzhongwen that the garrison had been hollowed out and would collapse from the inside even if the walls held. He therefore spent nothing more on holding the place: with a little over sixty riders he broke out of the west gate, slipped between the two columns and rode back to Chang'an, keeping the loss to a handful of men. What he did afterwards shows the better mind of the man: Yang Jian made him Commander of the March for Henan, sent him to raise troops at Luoyang against Tanrang, and there he won the action at Liang Commandery, cutting off the eastern leg of the rebellion before the march on Ye was attempted.
data: 此役可核的數字有限，但有幾項相當明確。時間是北周大象二年（580）七月；尉遲迥同年六月在鄴城起兵，河北之亂自入夏延續到入秋，尉遲迥本人於八月兵敗身死。首戰的斬獲是五百餘人，這是《資治通鑑》卷一百七十四記于仲文擊破宇文威的數字。出走的兵力是六十餘騎，僅及郡兵的一小部分，說明突圍是一支精銳而非全軍。叛軍的規模只有「旬日之間趙、魏、齊、兗、鄴五州皆應」「眾至數十萬」一類概數記載，並無可核的編制表。地理距離方面，石濟津在今河南延津東北，距滑臺不足八十里，騎兵急行可當日抵達；白馬津在滑縣之南，隔黃河與滑臺相望，水路數里即達，兩路合圍因此能在同一時間窗內完成。東郡是北周滑州治滑臺的治所郡，行政層級不高，但城防與儲糧屬州一級，郡兵人數有限，這正是守軍必須靠出城反擊爭取時間的根本原因。
dataEn: Few numbers survive for this engagement, but several are firm. The date is the seventh month of the Daxiang 2nd year of the Western Zhou, 580; Yuchi Jiong rose at Ye in the sixth month of the same year, and the Hebei rising ran from high summer into autumn, ending with Yuchi Jiong's own death at Ye in the eighth month. The harvest of the first action is given as more than five hundred enemy dead, the figure recorded in the Zizhi Tongjian, volume 174, for Yuzhongwen's defeat of Yuwen Wei. The force that broke out was a little over sixty riders, a fraction of the garrison, which shows the break-out was an elite detachment rather than the whole command. The scale of the insurgents survives only in round figures, that within ten days the five provinces of Zhao, Wei, Qi, Yong and Ye all answered, and a host counted in tens of thousands, with no verifiable table of organisation. As for distances, Shiji Ford lay north-east of present-day Yanjin in Henan, less than eighty li from Butai, close enough for mounted men to ride there in a day; Baima Ford lay south of Hua County, across the Yellow River from Butai and only a few li away by water, which is why the two columns could close on the city within the same interval. Dongjun was the commandery city of the prefecture of Hua in the Western Zhou, with its seat at Butai; an administrative rank of no great weight, but with a wall and with stores worthy of a prefecture, and with a garrison too small to be numbered, which is the root reason the defence had to turn on a sortie.
cause: 尉遲迥起兵的直接原因，是楊堅在北周的權力膨脹。北周宣帝宇文贇晚年猜忌多殺，誅除宗室與大將，尉遲迥身為相州總管、握河北重兵，恐自己成為下一個被清除的對象。宣帝暴崩之後，四歲的周靜帝宇文閔即位，楊堅以丞相身份總攬軍國，罷免、猜忌各地總管，把禁軍與政令牢牢抓在中央，尉遲迥所依賴的舊有分權格局為之崩解。表面上的口號是清君側，實際上卻是要搶在中央處置自己之前，先以河北五州的人馬問鼎。他散佈檄文，數楊堅專權、欺主之罪，號召州郡響應；滎州、襄州等地的舊部也隨之蜂起，形成多點開花的內亂。東郡是河南道北端的要衝，扼黃河渡口，北通鄴城，南接洛陽與梁郡，尉遲迥要向洛陽方向擴張，就必須先解決東郡；而對楊堅而言，東郡是插在河北叛軍與洛陽之間的一枚釘子，必須先拔除。因此東郡攻防不是孤立事件，而是整個平叛棋局上的一步。
causeEn: The immediate cause of Yuchi Jiong's rising was the growth of Yang Jian's power in the Western Zhou. The last Zhou emperor, Yuwen Yun, had been jealous and bloodthirsty, killing off members of the imperial clan and senior generals; Yuchi Jiong, as Inspector General of Xiang and holder of the military authority of Hebei, feared that he would be next on the list. When Yuwen Yun died suddenly, the four-year-old Yuwen Min succeeded as Emperor Jing, and Yang Jian, as Chancellor, took over the government and the army, dismissing and watching the provincial commanders and gripping the palace guards and the edicts in the centre; the old distribution of power on which Yuchi Jiong relied came apart. The ostensible slogan was to clear the ruler's side, but the reality was that he meant to move before the centre moved against him, raising the men of five Hebei provinces in a bid for power. He circulated a proclamation counting Yang Jian's abuses, monopolising authority and encroaching on the sovereign, and summoned the prefectures to join; old subordinates in Xingzhou and Xiangzhou rose in answer, and the revolt spread from point to point. Dongjun commanded the northern end of Henan, the Yellow River crossings, the road north to Ye and the road south to Luoyang and Liang Commandery. To drive toward Luoyang Yuchi Jiong had to dispose of Dongjun; to Yang Jian, Dongjun was a nail driven between the rebels of Hebei and Luoyang, and had to be pulled out first. The defence of the town was therefore not an isolated episode but one move in the larger game of the suppression.
impact: 東郡之戰是尉遲迥之亂中最早見分曉的一環，意義不在一郡一城，而在於向楊堅證明河北可以平。尉遲迥旬日之間整合五州、兵眾號稱數十萬，是北周末年最大的一次內部挑戰；滑臺失守之後，叛軍的東翼與洛陽之間再無屏障，楊堅得以集中兵力各個擊破，五月至八月間先後平定東線與南線，最終在鄴城結束這場叛亂。平叛之後，楊堅消除了一位握有河北兵權的宗室重臣，軍權、府兵與州鎮的編制都收歸中央，兩年後受禪代周建立隋朝，四年之後南下滅陳，統一南北。對地方而言，東郡這類處在交通要衝的州郡在戰亂中被反覆徵發糧秣與兵員，城防殘破；河南道北端自此長期為中央經營南方的北面基地，洛陽的戰略地位被重新抬高。對于仲文而言，突圍不死、陣亡者少，使他從一名郡守升為掌握洛陽兵權的行軍總管，日後在隋滅陳的戰役中得以獨當一面。
impactEn: The Dongjun action was the first thing to be decided in Yuchi Jiong's rising, and its importance lay not in one city but in what it proved to Yang Jian: that Hebei could be reduced. Yuchi Jiong had within ten days welded together five provinces and a host counted in tens of thousands, the largest internal challenge the late Western Zhou faced. Once Butai fell, the insurgents' eastern flank and Luoyang were no longer separated, and Yang Jian was able to concentrate his forces and strike in turn, settling the eastern and southern lines and ending the rebellion at Ye. With the revolt crushed, the one member of the imperial house who commanded the armies of Hebei was removed; military command, the fu-bing system and the organisation of the prefectures all came under central control, and two years later Yang Jian took the throne from the Zhou and founded the Sui, whose forces crossed the river four years after that to destroy Chen and unify north and south. Locally, commanderies like Dongjun, lying on the lines of movement, were repeatedly stripped of grain and men and left with broken walls; the northern end of Henan Circuit became the base from which the centre organised the south, and the strategic weight of Luoyang was raised accordingly. For Yuzhongwen, breaking out alive with so few men lost turned a provincial governorship into command of the troops of Luoyang, and he went on to command a wing of the Sui army in the conquest of Chen.
result: 結局是東郡陷落，但兩邊的收穫並不相同。城破之後，尉遲迥的兩路大軍進佔滑臺，白馬津與石濟津的渡口盡落叛軍之手，黃河下游的漕運與通往洛陽的路線一度中斷；但于仲文早一步率六十餘騎突圍，郡中精銳得以保全，他本人亦安全返回長安，兵力的損失極小。內應者赫連僧伽、敬子哲等人把東郡變成叛軍的內應點，等於不打自破，說明此役決定勝負的不是攻城技術，而是城內的忠誠與士氣。楊堅隨即起用于仲文為河南道行軍總管，赴洛陽發兵討檀讓，於梁郡之戰取勝，叛軍東線隨之瓦解。八月，尉遲迥在鄴城兵敗，率眾南走時被追兵追上而死，趙、魏、齊、兗諸州先後平定，河北重歸中央控制。河北的平定讓楊堅在北周的權威再無對手，也為其代周建隋鋪平了道路。
resultEn: The outcome was that Dongjun fell, but the two sides gained very differently from it. After the city was taken, the two columns of Yuchi Jiong occupied Butai, and the crossings at Baima and Shiji, with the Yellow River traffic below and the road toward Luoyang, were for a time in the insurgents' hands. Yet Yuzhongwen had already led a little over sixty riders out of the west gate, so the core of the garrison was preserved and he himself reached Chang'an alive, with the loss reduced to a very small number. Helian Sengjia, Jing Zizhe and the other sympathisers inside the walls had turned Dongjun into a breach through which the rebels entered without having to batter the gates, which shows that this battle was decided not by the science of siege but by the loyalty and the morale of the garrison. Yang Jian then employed Yuzhongwen as Commander of the March for Henan; he raised troops at Luoyang, engaged Tanrang and won the action at Liang Commandery, and the eastern leg of the rebellion came apart. In the eighth month Yuchi Jiong was defeated at Ye; he tried to escape south with his men, was overtaken by the pursuing cavalry and killed, and the provinces of Zhao, Wei, Qi and Yong were pacified in turn, returning Hebei to central control. The reduction of Hebei left Yang Jian without a rival within the Zhou, and prepared the road for him to replace the Zhou and found the Sui.
